label: #3618230: Adopt the ajax MessageCommand for file uploads, pinned core
description: Open /node/add/article in both frames. Upload a .txt file larger than 1 KB to trigger the server-side file size upload error. Before: messages are server-rendered inside the replaced widget prefix directly without using MessageCommand wrapper elements. After (MR !16777): messages are delivered via the AJAX MessageCommand targeting a dedicated container with class file-upload-messages.
status: draft: written from an issue pack; steps and checks have not been confirmed by a person

steps.text: Article content type with a 1 KB size limit file field exists.
Prepare a .txt file on your local machine larger than 1 KB (for example 5 KB).
In EACH frame, select the Attachment file input and upload the oversized file to trigger the server-side validation error AJAX callback.
steps.lookFor: Check if the error message is inserted into a dedicated file-upload-messages container.

expected: The file upload error is rendered using the AJAX MessageCommand targeting the file-upload-messages wrapper container.
actual: Before: messages are directly embedded in the widget prefix response. After: a div with class file-upload-messages is rendered and targeted by MessageCommand.

checks.label: The file input field on the article form exists on the page
The message container added by MR !16777 for MessageCommand targeting exists on the page
No JavaScript errors on the page (ignoring the harmless ResizeObserver loop notice)

observe.label: An error message appears after uploading a file larger than 1 KB
The error message is rendered inside a dedicated file-upload-messages container
